method: Read-only Windows process counters. Named WARP service, UI and recursive descendants; shared resident pages counted separately for every process. CPU is a percentage of one logical CPU. The GUI was launched without connecting or changing settings. The existing WARP service remained running throughout.

open_window.conditions: Disconnected Home screen visible, no user input. Rust compilation was stopped before this interval. Other normal host applications remained running.

background_service_only.caveat: Toolchain downloads and Rust compilation ran during part of this interval. This is an observation under development workload, not a controlled idle comparison.

closed_window_snapshot.caveat: One snapshot after closing the window, not a five-minute interval or CPU measurement. The UI process remained alive and hidden.

comparison_limits: WARP includes its service. Quad9's earlier 394.00 MiB window and 27.24 MiB tray measurements exclude its separately measured service.
The applications provide different networking features and were sampled in separate intervals. These observations are not a controlled product ranking.
WARP's published device RAM requirements do not describe its process working set.
